name: audiogen-cpp
description: ACE-Step text-to-music engine in pure C++/ggml, from qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp's engines/audiogen. This pin moves onto the shared master REF 1823ab31 that tts-cpp, parakeet-cpp and whisper-cpp also use, and onto the shared ggml-speech 2026-08-03, so all four -cpp ports build from one source archive against one ggml. engines/audiogen/ is byte-identical between the previous pin (26803b09) and this one, so the engine itself does not change: it still carries QVAC-22955 sequential lazy stage loading, where create() loads each stage right before its step and frees it right after, bounding the peak resident set to a single stage so a non-entitled iOS app is no longer jetsam-killed mid-load. The ggml-speech floor stays a hard dependency rather than a courtesy bump: the ACE-Step FSQ detokenizer casts a Q4_K special-tokens tensor to F32 in-graph and runs on the GPU only under Vulkan, so before qvac-ext-ggml PR #47 every Vulkan runner aborted on 'Missing CPY op for types: q4_K f32', with no CPU fallback to absorb it. The new floor adds the Adreno OpenCL ops from PR #49 and the unaligned-M im2col fusion from PR #50 on top, and carries the Vulkan snake / col2im_1d kernels and GGML_PREC_F32 matmul paths from PRs #45 / #46.
